name: Hypnotic Specter
text: Flying\nWhenever Hypnotic Specter deals damage to an opponent, that player discards a card at random.
flavor: "There was no trace\nOf aught on that illumined face . . . ."\n—Samuel Taylor Coleridge, "Phantom"
rulings: [{'date': '2008-08-01', 'text': 'The ability triggers even if the Specter’s damage is being redirected to an opponent. It does not trigger if damage that would have been dealt to the opponent is redirected to a nonopponent player or a creature, or if the damage is prevented.'}]

name: Hinder
text: Counter target spell. If that spell is countered this way, put that card on the top or bottom of its owner's library instead of into that player's graveyard.
rulings: [{'date': '2020-08-07', 'text': "Hinder's controller, not necessarily the controller of the countered spell, chooses where the countered spell goes."}]

name: Pyroclasm
text: Pyroclasm deals 2 damage to each creature.

name: Giant Growth
text: Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn.

name: Putrefy
text: Destroy target artifact or creature. It can't be regenerated.
rulings: [{'date': '2006-02-01', 'text': "This spell isn't modal. When it resolves, it will destroy the target if it's a creature or an artifact, even if it changed from one to the other between targeting and resolution."}]

name: Zombify
text: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

name: Lightning Helix
text: Lightning Helix deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
rulings: [{'date': '2017-11-17', 'text': "If the chosen target is illegal when Lightning Helix tries to resolve, it won't resolve and none of its effects will happen. You won't gain 3 life."}]
